subject: general
question: In total how many biosphere reserves are there in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**18**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• As of now, India has a total of **18 biosphere reserves** distributed across the country.
 
• These biosphere reserves are areas of terrestrial and coastal ecosystems promoting solutions to reconcile the conservation of biodiversity with its sustainable use.
 
• The **first biosphere reserve** in India was the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve, established in 1986.
 
• Some notable biosphere reserves include **Sundarbans, Nanda Devi, Nokrek, and Great Nicobar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Biosphere Reserves**

 
 
• Biosphere reserves are areas of terrestrial and coastal/marine ecosystems or a combination thereof, which are internationally recognized within the framework of UNESCO's Man and the Biosphere (MAB) Programme.
 
• The main aim of biosphere reserves is to conserve biological and cultural diversity, and promote economic and social development through partnerships between people and nature.
 
• Biosphere reserves involve local communities and all interested stakeholders in planning and management.
 
• They integrate three main "functions": conservation of biodiversity, economic development, and logistic support for research and education.
 
 
 
• **Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve**
 
 
• It is the **first biosphere reserve** in India, established in 1986.
 
• The reserve encompasses parts of Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Karnataka.
 
• The Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve is known for its rich biodiversity, including several endangered species of flora and fauna.
 
 
 
• **Sundarbans Biosphere Reserve**
 
 
• It is located in the Ganges Delta and is known for its unique mangrove forests.
 
• The Sundarbans is home to the famous Royal Bengal Tiger and many other species of wildlife.
 
• The area is also recognized for its role in protecting the coastal regions from cyclones and tidal surges.
 
 
 
• **Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve**
 
 
• Situated in the state of Uttarakhand, it includes the Nanda Devi and Valley of Flowers National Parks.
 
• It is known for its diverse alpine flora and fauna, including several endangered species.
 
• The area is also a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
